entities.summary: Rakefet Russak-Aminoach is a Managing Partner at Team8, a global venture fund, and the Chairperson of Hailo Technologies. Russak Aminoach served as president and CEO of Bank Leumi from May 1, 2012, to October 2019. In 2024 Rakefet joined the board of BNY.
